freeze.rule: Training minimum log loss on fixed 0/.25/.5/.75/1 grid; validation must improve log loss, otherwise weight zero. No held-out selection.

limitations: Small diagnostic screen; observations correlated within matches; seed batches are uncertainty units.
Offline fit conditions on original ranges; fresh evaluation applies mixture to within-hand likelihoods and may change trajectories.
Observer features describe the forecasting player's own visible hand, never target hidden cards.
Family labels are external diagnostic metadata only; no opponent identities are fitted.
Proper scores and reliability bins do not establish profit gains.
